Translate a .NET design into concrete projects, source files, and runnable CLI commands.

## Rules
- Idiomatic C# and modern SDK-style project files.
- Keep changes minimal and consistent with existing repo style.
- Commands must be runnable after placeholder replacement.

## Output
Inputs · Project and code artifacts · Build and run commands · Expected result · Risks
